<p>Alright, Thad Huguley and Debbie Reilly – I finally got your football schedule delivered! Keep the reminders coming, all – I need that kind of teamwork to get this out every week!</p><p>This past weekend was so much fun! It was different…but college football is back! I, honestly, do not have a lot of insight that you all do not have at this point, but here are some of the water cooler discussions that we may all have enjoyed because…it’s college football season again! Woohoo!</p><p>Coach Saban is such a strong addition to the ESPN <em>College Game Day </em>team that his participation on the pregame show is going to hurt attendance at all the morning kickoff games! And the worries about our new head coach not cursing were all for naught. Did we forget? UA still has Coach Saban on contract! So, as a team player Coach Saban will graciously cover the required <em>coach’s curse word quota</em> as was fulfilled with his wise comment on <em>College Game Day</em> about the transfer portal,&nbsp;</p><p>&nbsp;<em>“If you don’t pay the right guys, you’ll be shit out of luck.”</em></p><p>The GOAT has <u>all</u> our <em>new coach</em> <em>adjustment</em> concerns covered so Coach DeBoer can focus on getting it done on Saturdays! Teamwork at its finest!&nbsp;</p><p>Speaking of fine teamwork…we see you Vandy! You showed Virginia Tech there’s room for only one “V” team in the FirstBank Stadium (Commodore home stadium). AND you almost won the best college football player name battle with your very own De’Rickey Wright vs. VA Tech’s Kyron Drones, but Kyron Drones wins that contest by a smidge. Vandy, you made the SEC proud!&nbsp;</p><p>But LSU…you did not! Fifth straight season opener you have gone 0-1?! Y’all gonna have to schedule a scrimmage with another team on Week 0 to break this trend?! Though that approach did not go so well for FSU. ☹ Now, it’s not the end of the world to lose your season opener or first two games of the season…but as one clever fan pointed out with this meme, it may be the end of your season:</p><p><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="image" height="242" width="246"></p><p>&nbsp;But look on the bright side, without the pressure of going to the playoffs on your back, y’all can go out there and just play for fun with your team, right?…Said no one <em>ever</em> to an Alabama fan and lived to tell about it.&nbsp;</p><p>Let’s get ready to welcome another team to whip up on in Bryant Denny and dedicate that Saban Field in Week Two of college football! Enjoy and RTR!</p><p>Jackie&nbsp;</p>
